scope: Independent phrase-mark overlay. No harmony, timing, notes, source bricks, formal labels, display sections or layout are altered.
terminalContract: starts contains actual onsets below end only. Host may append end for a bright closing line only when closesAtEnd is true; that closure is not another phrase label.
default: Every four actual measures from chart start. Meter determines quarter-note conversion.

sources.basis: Default1-based measures1,5,9…; phrasePatch shifts the selected current boundary and all later defaults; sentinel is not a chart phrase onset.
Authoring documentation confirms moving defaults for anacrusis, added bars or shortening.
Four-measure loop phrases use white vertical bars; cadences describe functional arrivals, not a rule for every chord or modulation.
Dynamic catalogue of tagged examples, including uneven/shortened/extra-bar/padding examples and uncertain think_later annotations.
69 public rendition references with actual MIDI grids; none chart-aligned for safe phrase transfer.
Only previously source-audited formal section extents may reset a default grid at an irregular section boundary.
